_comment: Hand-maintained. This file changes every season and must never be derived logic.
Values below were confirmed by scripts/probe.ts on 2026-08-22.
rewardItemLevels maps a difficulty/keystone tier to the ilvl actually awarded.
It exists because items.base_item_level is the JOURNAL base ilvl and is NOT what
you receive - the same M+ rotation contains dungeons with base ilvls of 219 and 108.
Fill in the keystone table from in-game or Wowhead when you want cross-tier display.
